sections.title: How weapons work
paragraphs: Lead designer Ez Jämsen describes Frostrail as guns-first rather than melee-first. Pistols, shotguns, rifles, and machine guns form the announced firearm families, with basic melee available earlier and a secondary melee action on ranged weapons.
Ammunition is framed as a valuable resource, so the official design messaging treats combat as a serious cost rather than an unlimited shooting gallery.
bullets: WWI-influenced firearm direction
Crafting is planned for all guns
Modular parts and weapon-modifying stations
No reliable public damage comparison yet

sections.title: Crafting & modifications
paragraphs: The developers say firearms are craftable and modular. In the official Assembly Station screenshot, the Bolt-Action Rifle uses interchangeable stocks and displays a concrete assembly requirement: slag metal ×5, wood ×3, and cloth ×2.
That screen lists Wooden, Padded, and Bare Bolt-Action Rifle Stock options. The selected Padded stock weighs 0.3 kg and shows +0.0% recoil and +0.0% stability in that captured build.

sections.title: Weapon data FAQ
paragraphs: The screenshot values are official visual evidence, but they belong to an in-development build and are not presented as final Early Access balance. Damage rankings remain inappropriate because no comparable public stat panel exists for the Pipe Rifle, pistols, shotguns, machine guns, or melee weapons.
bullets: Reference-design mockup names remain excluded
Official screenshot values are labeled pre-release
Future beta or Early Access values should retain build and verification context

sections.title: Resource loop
paragraphs: The crew leaves the train to scavenge settlements, wreckage, ruins, bunkers, strongholds, and dungeons, then brings recovered materials back to onboard stations. Resources support weapons, equipment, repair, expansion, storage, heat, and motion.

Aku Jauhiainen gives one concrete production example: metal scraps are processed into slag metal and then pure metal. He says wood and plastic follow similar refinement logic, but does not publish every intermediate name or ratio.
bullets: Scavenge the frozen levels
Return materials to the train
Refine metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Use comparable refining systems for wood and plastic

sections.title: Documented material requirement
paragraphs: One official Steam screenshot provides exact pre-release material quantities for assembling the pictured Bolt-Action Rifle: five slag metal, three wood, and two cloth. This is valid screenshot evidence, but it should not be generalized to other guns or assumed final for Q4 2026 Early Access.

sections.title: Fields awaiting verification
paragraphs: The development team has not published stack sizes, weights, node locations, processing ratios, yields, rarity, or complete recipe relationships for these resources.
facts: General scavenging confirmed; exact locations TBA

sections.title: Confirmed crafting loop
paragraphs: Players scavenge materials in the frozen world, return to the train, and use onboard production facilities to strengthen both crew and locomotive. Weapons are planned to be craftable and modular rather than purely random drops.

The clearest published refinement example converts metal scraps into slag metal and then pure metal. The founder says wood and plastic are refined in similar ways, connecting raw salvage to higher-grade production inputs.
bullets: Recover metal, cloth, plastic, fuel, and other supplies
Refine metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Use train-mounted benches, repair, cooking, and weapon stations
Expand the train with more facilities and storage

paragraphs: The May 2026 development update states that Relics are found in dungeons and activated aboard the train, where they provide temporary buffs. This connects dungeon expeditions to short-term advantages during the wider journey.

paragraphs: Relics were reported as a newest addition in the May 13, 2026 Spring Development Update, after the April closed playtest. facts: New modular assets and improved lighting
Added broadly; Relic persistence not specified

sections.title: Warmth & exposure

bolt-action-rifle.lede: The Bolt-Action Rifle is a craftable modular firearm documented in an official Assembly Station screenshot with a complete pre-release stat panel, material requirements, and three visible stock options.
bolt-action-rifle.imageAlt: Official Frostrail modular bolt-action rifle interface

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: FakeFish founder Aku Jauhiainen used the Bolt-Action Rifle to explain Frostrail's weapon progression and modular parts. The current official Steam gallery goes further: its Assembly Station screen names the rifle, shows a stock slot, lists three stock choices, displays assembly materials, and exposes the captured build's weapon statistics.
All values below are transcribed from that official image. They are authoritative evidence for the pictured pre-release build, but not guaranteed Early Access balance.

sections.title: Detailed stats
paragraphs: The official Assembly Station screenshot shows the following values. Negative percentages are preserved exactly as displayed; the image does not explain whether they are base penalties, assembled modifiers, or UI conventions.

sections.title: How to get
paragraphs: The screenshot confirms that this rifle can be assembled when its material requirements are met. It does not reveal when the recipe unlocks or whether the completed weapon can also spawn as loot, drop from enemies, or appear through a merchant.
facts: Later than the early-game Pipe Rifle — developer comparison

sections.title: Crafting recipe
paragraphs: The Assembly Station displays three material requirements for the pictured rifle. No craft time, station tier, blueprint requirement, output quality, or ammunition recipe is visible.

sections.title: Stock options & modifiers
paragraphs: The visible stock slot offers Wooden Bolt-Action Rifle Stock, Padded Bolt-Action Rifle Stock, and Bare Bolt-Action Rifle Stock. The selected Padded stock has the description “Gaudy and offering small false comforts to the Pilgrim judgment is rightly delivered.”
facts: Visible on model; names not readable

sections.title: Interpretation & data limits
paragraphs: A single screenshot is enough to document the displayed stats and recipe, but not enough to rank the rifle against other guns or prescribe an optimal build. Ammo type, reload duration in seconds, rarity, range, durability loss per shot, headshot multiplier, critical behavior, and stock comparison values remain unverified.
bullets: Treat 27.0 as screenshot projectile damage, not a final launch value
Treat 5 as clip size; the ammo type is not shown
Do not convert modifier percentages into timing or recoil behavior without a playable build
Retain this page's pre-release label after future balance changes
